title: Coefficientwise positivity of the endpoint q-Narayana matrices
statement: For each of the two endpoint $q$-Narayana triangles $T^{(e)}(q)$, corresponding to the type $A$ and type $B$ endpoints, every minor of $T^{(e)}(q)$ is a polynomial in $q$ with nonnegative integer coefficients; equivalently, $T^{(e)}(q)$ is coefficientwise totally nonnegative over $\mathbb{N}[q]$.
references: - [Two q-Deformations of Narayana Polynomials: Rogers Moments, Hankel Positivity, and q-Narayana Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28691) — arXiv — Jiang Zeng

progress.label: Open · progress reported
progress.tldr: An unrefereed preprint confirms the conjecture through the second level, but does not settle the general problem.
progress.summary:
The problem concerns a conjecture asserting coefficientwise total nonnegativity for endpoint $q$-Narayana matrices. The general conjecture remains broader than the result currently reported.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28691)*

**October 2026 verification through order two**

Jiang Zeng reports verification through order two, together with total-positivity and moment representations for related kernels. This is substantive partial progress, but it does not establish the conjecture in full.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28691)*

Current status (as of October 2026): The conjecture is claimed verified through order two, while the general coefficientwise total-nonnegativity statement remains open.

*Caveats. The reported result is from an unrefereed preprint and has not been independently verified.*
